meta.title: Healthstack
meta.description: A specialized IDE for lifestyle optimization on Eclipse Theia: biomarker tracking, unit conversion, and a purpose-built DSL for intervention protocols. Currently a private dev build.

hero.title: Protocols as code. Biology as data. AI as your cortex.
hero.lead: Healthstack is a specialized IDE for lifestyle optimization on Eclipse Theia: biomarker tracking, unit conversion, and a purpose-built DSL for intervention protocols.
hero.imageAlt: Biomarker dashboard in the Healthstack dev build
hero.caption: Thumbnail - Healthstack dev build

sections.heading: Timeline
sections.title: Your entire protocol history on *one axis*.
sections.proof: Every protocol, dose, and threshold on one axis: planned against actual, with threshold events armed and crossed, dose dots per phase, and the whole history exportable to your calendar.
sections.imageAlt: Unified timeline from July to December 2026: the Metabolic Reset phases Prep, Insulin Sensitivity, Lipid Optimization and Maintenance as dashed planned bars with dose dots above solid actual bars, a red NOW marker, and daily HRV, resting heart rate, sleep and step readings below with amber threshold-armed points.
sections.caption: Dev build - timeline

sections.heading: Protocol builder
sections.title: Compose protocols like a graph, not a spreadsheet.
sections.proof: Substances are nodes, synergies and conflicts are edges, and tracks reach from protocol to biomarker. The graph auto-relayouts, and because a protocol is text, it versions in git.
sections.imageAlt: Protocol Builder graph of the Metabolic Reset protocol: the protocol node fans out to four phases, ten interventions and four substances, dotted blue track edges run to ten biomarkers, and a red dashed conflict edge links Berberine and Metformin.
sections.caption: Dev build - protocol builder

sections.heading: Biomarker tracker
sections.title: Every lab value, in range or out.
sections.proof: Each value sits against its reference range with a status: optimal, good, or out. Sparklines show the trend, and units convert as you paste, mg/dL to mmol/L and back.
sections.imageAlt: Biomarker Tracker overview table: LDL cholesterol flagged Out of Range at 104 mg/dL, followed by markers rated Good or Optimal, each with its latest value and unit, a bar showing its position in the range, a sparkline and a percentage trend.
sections.caption: Dev build - biomarker tracker

sections.heading: Trends
sections.title: See the curve, not just the number.
sections.proof: Multiple markers compared on one chart, range bands drawn over time, event markers where protocols started or ended, values normalized across different labs, and an AI hand-off for analysis.
sections.imageAlt: Two stacked trend charts on a shared April 2025 to October 2026 timeline: ApoB falling to 84 mg/dL and LDL cholesterol to 104 mg/dL toward shaded reference and optimal bands, both marked improving.
sections.caption: Dev build - trends

sections.heading: AI agents
sections.title: Cortex orchestrates *your Healthstack*.
sections.proof: Agents with roles: Cortex coordinates, Evidence searches PubMed through MCP, BiomarkerAnalyst reads labs, ProtocolPlanner drafts .bio files. Bring your own key, multi-provider.
sections.imageAlt: Ask Cortex chat panel beside the Protocol Builder graph, with suggested prompts addressed to @BiomarkerAnalyst, @Evidence and @ProtocolPlanner and a note that agent tool calls ask for confirmation first.
sections.caption: Dev build - Cortex chat

dsl.heading: The DSL
dsl.body: Protocols are data, not prose, and the language's type system is written in the language itself: `substance`, `intervention`, `stack`, and `protocol` are user-extendable `type` declarations in `.bio`, not hardcoded in the grammar. The editor below runs the real language server in this tab. Your data never leaves your machine. It opens with a sample that defines its own types, then extends them; the other samples cover a curated supplement library and the live interaction checker.
dsl.label: Playground · .bio language server, runs in your browser
dsl.fallbackLabel: Playground not bundled with this build
dsl.fallbackBody: The .bio language server is not included here. Run the full build chain to embed the live editor on this page.

status.heading: Status
status.title: Preview build
status.body: Everything on this page is the dev build: it runs, the DSL compiles, the diagnostics fire. Expect rough edges, no data guarantees, and no product promises. The screenshots are real, taken from the app as it works today. A public preview is not hosted yet; when it is, it will appear here.
